text.autoconfig.sol_valheim.title: SOL: Valheim
text.autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.commo: Duration is nutrition × saturation modifier × this value, with a minimum of 5 minutes.
Higher values slow regeneration; lower values speed it up.
During this period you can sprint without eating.
Keep all active food, drinks, and remaining timers on death. Disabled: remove entries below 20% duration and reduce retained timers to one fifth.
Speed bonus when food grants at least 20 health points; 0 disables it.
Base hearts before food bonuses. Other mods can still add health.
Cap for base hearts plus food bonuses; defaults to 30 hearts (3 rows). Other mods can still add health.
Total number of active foods and drinks, from 2 to 5. At most one slot can contain a drink.
Replace or refresh food below this fraction of its duration, or during the final minute. Set to 0.5 to refill below 50%.
While a drink is active, multiply health and regeneration by 1 plus this value.
Account for skipped night time without increasing existing timers.
Convert hunger costs into food time
Hunger deductions and exhaustion shorten active food timers. Disable to ignore these costs while keeping hunger replaced by the food system.
Time budget for directly deducting 1 hunger point (half a drumstick), shared between active slots before applying the curve. 0 disables direct costs.
Separate time budget for exhaustion from movement, mining, hunger effects, or mods. 4 exhaustion equals 1 vanilla hunger point. 0 disables exhaustion costs.
Multiply each slot's time budget by (remaining/full duration) raised to this power. Default 0.5: less remaining time costs less. 0 gives a constant cost; range 0 to 2.
Share hunger costs between foods and the drink slot. Disable to spend only food time; ordinary drink countdowns still apply.
Edit the JSON5 configuration file to customize individual foods.
text.autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.clien: Enlarge the food icons; timer text stays at native font scale.
Enabled by default: show remaining-time bars below food and drink icons. Disable to show numeric countdowns with m/s units.
Choose Adjust HUD position on the mod configuration home screen and drag the preview. Disable to restore automatic placement alongside vanilla status bars.
gui.sol_valheim.position_help: Drag the food icon to adjust its position Arrow keys for fine-tuning Shift to accelerate Ctrl to disable center snapping
